name: smwmusic-super-smash-bros-melee-break-the-targets
title: Super Smash Bros. Melee - Break The Targets
description:
This track is jazzy, fast-paced, and short in length; it appears during minigames in Super Smash Bros. Melee, and would be most suitable for bonus stages, minigames, or switch palaces in SMW as well.

Inserting this song higher up in the song list (i.e. with a smaller song ID value) may allow you to fit more into ARAM.

Not compatible with P-Switch, Thunder, Game Over, Bonus End, or Star.
